title: One Pan Bacon Ranch Cheddar Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-size cubes
Slap Ya Mama seasoning, to taste (optional, for spice)
instructions: To a large skillet add 12 ounces of chopped bacon. Cook at medium to low temperature. Once bacon is about 3/4 way cooked through, add 1 small diced yellow onion. Cook until bacon is crispy. Remove the bacon from the pan leaving the bacon grease in the pan.

Cut 1 1/2 pounds of chicken into bite-size cubes. Season well with 1 - 1 1/2 tablespoons of ranch seasoning and slap ya mama seasoning to taste (skip if you don't like spice). Add 2 tablespoons of corn starch. Mix until everything is coated well.
Add the chicken to the bacon grease at medium to high heat. Cook 3 minutes then flip and cook another 3 minutes. Toss around in the pan for about 30 seconds. Remove chicken from pan.

Add 4 cups of low sodium chicken broth and 1 pound of pasta to the pan. Season again with the same seasonings. Cook on high for 8-10 minutes, tossing every couple of minutes while boiling. Once the liquid is about absorbed, lower the heat and add 1 cup of heavy cream. Mix and add 2-3 cups of freshly shredded cheddar cheese. Mix until melted.
Add bacon and chicken back to the pan and mix.
notes: Posted by Andrea on Facebook. Radiatori pasta is recommended — its ruffled shape holds the creamy sauce well. Use freshly shredded cheddar (not pre-shredded) for better melting.
